payload.title: edge-agent-release cross build cannot find the root workspace manifest for the path dependency crates/alarm-core, and no PR job exercises the cross build, so every agent release build has failed since alarm-core was added
evidence: sens-api-gateway/Cargo.toml:23 (alarm-core = { path = "../crates/alarm-core" }; the crate inherits edition, version and rust-version from the root workspace manifest, added in 400fbf234 on 2026-07-13)
sens-api-gateway/Cross.toml:14 ([build.env] passthrough only; cross mounts the gateway and each path dependency but not the repository-root Cargo.toml)
.github/workflows/edge-agent-release.yml:233 (cross build exited 101 on all three targets for tag agent-v2.0.0-rc.6, run 40668157738: failed to find a workspace root for crates/alarm-core/Cargo.toml)
.github/workflows/sens-api-gateway-ci.yml:119 (the release-profile gate runs a host-native cargo check; no PR workflow ran cross build)
payload.rule_violated: A release build path must be exercised by a PR gate before a tag depends on it, and every directory a path dependency needs to resolve its workspace must be visible to the cross container
payload.notes: Fix: Cross.toml [build.env] volumes = [CROSS_REPO_ROOT]; the release workflow and a new PR job (cross-build-smoke, x86_64) set CROSS_REPO_ROOT to the checkout and run the release cross invocation. The gateway CI path filters now include crates/alarm-core, crates/local-rumqttc and the root Cargo.toml. Version 2.0.0-rc.7 because the release workflow builds the commit a tag points at and agent-v2.0.0-rc.5 / rc.6 stay where they are.
